function.name: execute_sql_query
function.description: Executes a read-only SQL SELECT query against the structured customer analytics database. Use this tool when retrieving relational metrics such as order counts, customer account statuses, or transaction histories. Do NOT use this tool for searching unstructured documentation or markdown guides; use search_knowledge_base instead. Only SELECT statements are permitted; queries time out after timeout_ms (100–60000 ms) and return at most max_rows rows when specified.

query.description: Exact read-only SQL SELECT query targeting documented analytics tables (no DDL or DML statements).

timeout_ms.description: Query execution timeout in integer milliseconds (100 to 60000, e.g., 5000).

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to return (integer 1 to 10000), or null to apply the default server limit.
